contract_models.fee_type: optional subscription or agreed service price
contract_models.financial_group_effect: total-cost comparison may reduce distribution/packaging rents
contract_models.conflict: ranking quality and customer mandate; multiple AI providers can contest access

contract_models.financial_group_effect: cost savings may be passed to customers; cannot assume all retained as profit
partner share may absorb margin even when volume grows
contract_models.conflict: paid ranking; compliance/disclosure/appropriateness and prohibited fees remain

contribution_model.scope: single comparable repeatable operating task, legal entity, currency, customer cohort and period; not insurance-contract accounting profit
contribution_model.p: actual average earned revenue per completed paid task
contribution_model.c: non-overlapping task-level costs, partner share and applicable risk/funding/capital burden
contribution_model.F: incremental period fixed cost not already included in c
contribution_model.L: old-business net contribution lost; savings in that business reflected once
contribution_model.N: completed paid tasks in the same period
contribution_model.positive_condition: if p > c, N > (F + L) / (p - c)
limits: No fixed-cost, FTP, capital or loss double counting
Whole-company before/after already contains cannibalization; do not subtract it twice
Do not combine stock-based, transaction-based and insurance quantities in one N
Prices and costs can change with quantity; threshold is conditional, not estimated

competitive_rounds.competitor_action: free connection/CMS, direct distribution, bundled price, higher deposit rate or cheaper FX/credit, improved claims/operations
competitive_rounds.incumbent_effect: new service revenue and retained customer count may rise while margins fall

competitive_rounds.customer_action: reselect using actual price, final cash, servicing and switching costs
competitive_rounds.incumbent_choice: keep differentiating function, buy external function, reprice or exit unprofitable work

group_checks.BNK: separate individual-bank funding from total-system deposits and issuer reserves
group_checks.Kyobo: service-covered balances can overlap underlying AUM; distinguish actual origination and repeated claims
group_checks.Hanwha: premium cash, insurance revenue, liabilities, cohorts and investment results differ; ETF secondary trade is not automatically fund creation

observations: same-customer function-specific balance and transaction migration
effective total price and partner share
repeat paid completion and final usable cash
cannibalization and avoidable costs in one scope
legal rights, mistakes, loss and recovery
insurance long-term cohort and underwriting mix
